reason: I already run a tab at the dekkene and it costs me nothing extra. A list before 2 p.m. and a trip to a pickup point between 6 and 8 for a $2 fee on top, that is more hassle than what I do now.
objection: Sending a list before 2 p.m. every time is a hassle, and I still have to go collect it myself. On $6,000 a year, $2 a bag adds up, and I do not know the savings will cover it.
would_change_my_mind: If it were credit like the dekkene (pay at month end) or the fee were waived, and I could see the savings on my usual items first.
